page.layout: One column of index lines, running head "INDEX" at top; no margin notes visible; a stamp ("BIBLIOTECA ROMANA") at lower left, not transcribed.; One page of index text in two lines-columns; a single column of entries at the left, with a stamp at lower left (not transcribed).; One narrow strip of an index page, one column of lines at the right edge with page numbers after them; a letter heading X and Z stands centred in the strip.
page.notes: Right edge of the page is cut off, so the ends of several lines are missing; the last line "FI..." is a section heading cut short. Some entries are partly obscured by stains. Greek words in the entries are not legible at this scan and are not reproduced. The Greek letters at the left of the lines and the heading "E X." are as far as the scan shows. Only the right-hand strip of the page is visible; the lines are cut at their beginnings, so the left parts of the lines are incomplete. Some words are doubtful in the cut lines and are copied as far as they can be read. The numbers are printed in old-style figures.
